title: Smart Data Models - Gaia-X Ontology - SubContractor
description: https://w3id.org/gaia-x/2.1.11#class/SubContractor. Represents a subcontractor with specific legal and communication attributes.

id.description: Property. Unique identifier of the entity

type.description: Property. NGSI-LD Entity type. It must be equal to 'SubContractor'

dateModified.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. Timestamp of the last modification.

source.description: Property. A sequence of characters giving the source of the entity data.

dataProvider.description: Property. A sequence of characters identifying the provider of the harmonised data entity.

applicableJurisdiction.description: Property. The jurisdiction under which the subcontractor operates (ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code).

legalName.description: Property. The legal name of the subcontractor.

communicationMethods.description: Property. The method(s) of communication with the subcontractor (xsd:string or LegalDocument reference in the source ontology).

informationDocuments.description: Property. Documents providing additional information about the subcontractor (xsd:anyURI, LegalDocument reference, or literal string in the source ontology).
